description: pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:103-117 — CrlChecker::new() accepts any DER-encoded CertificateList, including delta CRLs. A caller who passes a delta CRL to new() gets incomplete revocation coverage (delta CRLs only contain entries since the last base CRL; entries in the base are not checked). The current documentation says 'To also apply a delta CRL, use CrlChecker::with_delta' but does not warn that passing a delta CRL to new() is an incorrect usage that silently under-covers revocations. Fix: add a # Security note in CrlChecker::new() that warns 'Do not pass a delta CRL (one containing a deltaCRLIndicator extension) as the sole CRL. Delta CRLs only contain partial revocation information; use CrlChecker::with_delta(base, delta, ...) for correct delta CRL handling.'
title: CrlChecker::new() silently accepts delta CRL without warning
